description: Evaluation suite, schema v2. Each task defines its fixture, instructions, allowed tools (enforced by the controller), max_iterations, timeout_s, success criteria, policy constraints and expected changes. 'fixed' tasks pass only if the controller reports succeeded AND independent held-out tests (evals/heldout/<fixture>.py, never visible to the agent) pass on the agent's diff. 'no_change' tasks pass only if the final diff is empty and no policy denial occurred. Task success and policy compliance are reported separately (clean_success).
